versions.changelog: Run AUTO_CD multi-repo deployments in parallel and collect all results before sending one summary notification; keep CI parallelism, duplicate-trigger fixes, and failure Jenkins links.
Restore parallel execution for multi-repo CI runs while keeping CD path serial; retain Jenkins duplicate-trigger fixes and failure CI/job links.
Fix duplicate Jenkins triggers by accepting 202/302 and normalizing param matching; always return Jenkins CI/job links on failure for troubleshooting.
Fix dl-admin as an independent deploy service instead of aliasing to cloud-admin
Add dl-admin alias for cloud-admin service resolution in deploy skill
Switch bundled deploy flow back to AUTO_CD on CI jobs; reserve separate CD jobs for explicit standalone deploys
Add shop services, fuzzy repo matching, and separate package vs deploy notifications
